scope: Local code, fake execution and actual Google interpretation only. No new robot motion, repeated physical execution or acoustic/ASR validation.
problem: A spoken request for ten push-ups was represented by one name-only play_trick call. The shipped fixed routine has two nominal lower/raise cycles, not one verified physical repetition.

implementation.tool: play_trick requires name,count,count_unit. Count integer1..10; units routine_playback or physical_repetition.
implementation.accepted: Only count1 with routine_playback. Unsupported physical counts/multiple playbacks refuse before preparing movement or queue insertion.
implementation.legacy_manual_route: POST /animation accepts animation_name only, explicitly requests one routine, and rejects extra fields instead of ignoring counts.
implementation.feedback: Closed typed refusal wording, with unknown/superseded precedence. No arbitrary server/model prose becomes an authoritative receipt.
implementation.unchanged: Existing policy, gains, limits, initialization, fade, Stop and internal single-playback behavior. Native-agent estimate corrections were preserved.
implementation.implementation_commit: 950988d, committed by root before this evidence report.

full_python_regression.includes: gemini_pupper/tests, installed skill sequences, selected session-profile tests

failing_before_evidence: Seven initial quantity contract cases failed before implementation.
Three legacy manual-endpoint cases demonstrated silently ignored quantity fields before extra-field rejection.
checks.peer_review: No blocking source finding; earlier17-file review and later narrow extra-field review preserved.

actual_gemini.observed: Ten physical push-ups and two routine playbacks were refused without actions or substitution. The information-only followup did not mutate. One routine, Sit and the ordered three-skill chain carried explicit one-playback fields and were accepted.
actual_gemini.narration: Recorded acceptance transcripts occurred after the actual fake-server replies; no unsupported physical repetition count was claimed in this bounded run.

rejected_alternative.candidate: Blanket model-issued push_up guard based on optional/unordered input transcription
rejected_alternative.decision: Not integrated because it disabled every voice push-up, including a legitimate one-routine request.
rejected_alternative.evidence: The SDK transcript carries no tool-request identity/order guarantee; finished text alone cannot authorize a matching action. Its four source files and tests are preserved in the archive.

remaining_limits: Required fields enforce submitted quantities, not that Gemini copied spoken intent correctly. A later model can still misinterpret a count.
One text-input sample per targeted request does not prove ASR or general model reliability.
No physical repetition counter or repeated-routine capability is added. Push-up heading drift remains separate work.
Accepted fake jobs were not necessarily complete at model turn end; cleanup ended fake work.
No blanket voice capability disable or automatic count-to-clip multiplication was adopted.
next_actions: Deploy client and server with the same tool schema when root schedules the next integration.
Use one routine explicitly until counted physical cycles and repeated execution are independently validated.
Test further spoken quantity interpretation without claiming the schema alone binds ASR to commands.
